title: What Scripture Actually Says About Your Phone
caption:
Scripture never mentions your phone. It mentions what's running you. Same fight, older name.

It's not a phone, it's a golden calf with a battery. What gets your eyes first gets your worship first. Every scroll is a small vote for who runs you. And you don't need a detox from it, you need a war.

Redeem the time, because the days are evil.
